summary: The preferences panel is correctly implemented in __init__.py with API key status display, model selection dropdown (defaulting to claude-sonnet-4.6), and timeout setting (default 30s). All settings persist through Blender's add-on preferences system.

issues.description: The default model 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6' uses a hyphen in 'sonnet' but the description says 'Claude Sonnet 4.6'. The actual OpenRouter model ID should be verified - it may need to be 'claude-sonnet-4' or similar. The slash in the model ID is stored as an EnumProperty identifier which is fine.

sharedStateObservations.description: API key is read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable at draw time. This is secure - the key value is never stored in preferences or displayed in UI.
Blender's AddonPreferences class is used with bpy.props EnumProperty and IntProperty for persistent settings storage.
The model ID format for OpenRouter is 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6' but workers should verify this is the correct current model identifier.
